info.name: Freshly RESTful API Suite
info.description:
Dokumentasi API lengkap untuk platform Freshly — AI Fruit Freshness Detection

📌 **SETUP REQUIRED:**
1. Salin file `.env.example` ke `.env` di folder backend
2. Set `CLIENT_KEY` di backend `.env` 
3. Import Freshly.local.postman_environment.json untuk environment variables
4. Pastikan nilai `clientKey` di environment sesuai dengan `CLIENT_KEY` di .env

🔗 **API Endpoint Prefix:** `/api/v1`
📧 **Support:** support@freshly.web.id
